strengths: Strong full-stack versatility across languages and domains
Active open-source contributor with proven mentoring and workshop leadership
Demonstrated ability to own ambiguous projects from concept to production
concerns: No evidence of 8 years of C++ experience — only brief early-career use
Lacks documented experience in cloud compute platforms, distributed systems, or infrastructure architecture
No prior technical leadership role mentoring cloud or DevOps engineers
